name: WhatsApp group lifecycle and participant sync
description:
## Context
Because the official Cloud API now exposes a Groups API, a codx-junior group chat and a WhatsApp group can be kept as one audience: people chatting in the app and people chatting in WhatsApp. Reference: https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/groups (verify endpoints/limits against the live doc; groups availability is subject to Meta rollout and business approval).

## Objective
Create or link a WhatsApp group from a messenger chat and keep participants in sync.

## Steps
1. Link an EXISTING group: store the WhatsApp group id in `ChannelBinding.external_id` (`external_type="group"`); accept it via API/UI (paste group id or an invite link that the client resolves).
2. Create a NEW group from a chat: `client.create_group(subject=chat.name, participant_wa_ids=<mapped users>)`, then store the returned group id + invite link in the binding `meta`.
3. Participant sync:
   - messenger → WhatsApp: when `chat.users` changes, `add_participants` / `remove_participants` for the mapped wa_ids (skip unmapped users and log them).
   - WhatsApp → messenger: handle `GroupEvent` (participant added/removed) from the webhook and update `chat.users`, adding a visible system message ("María joined from WhatsApp").
4. Join requests: list pending requests, expose approve/reject in the API/UI, notify the chat.
5. On group deletion/`403` from Meta: disable the binding and post a system message in the chat instead of retrying forever.

## Files
- codx/junior/channels/whatsapp/adapter.py
- codx/junior/channels/bridge.py
- codx/junior/channels/store.py

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A chat can be linked to an existing group and to a newly created group.
- [ ] Adding/removing a user in the messenger updates the WhatsApp group and vice versa.
- [ ] Join requests can be listed and approved from the app.
- [ ] A revoked/deleted group disables the binding with a clear system message.
